'''Xim'tahal''', better known as '''Xim'tahal the Defaced''', was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. The [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], better known as "Doc," incurred Xim'tahl's wrath on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Little Kessel]], and the encounter with the fierce Kaleesh convinced Doc to end his hobby of undermining criminals and despots across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and join the [[Balmorran resistance|native resistance]] on the planet of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in their [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|fight]] against Imperial occupation.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xim'tahal was mentioned the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a supplementary guide to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
